title: Best way to monitor a kid's glucose levels for the whole day
symptom: The user is a parent of a child with type 1 diabetes and wants to monitor the child's glucose levels throughout the day, especially while at school. They are considering using a smartwatch with 3G as a collector, but are concerned about battery life and the need to recharge.
fix: The thread suggests not using a watch as a collector; instead, have the child carry a phone as the master collector. For house coverage, use a phone with xDrip and a Bluecon or similar device. Also, the thread mentions using a phone with good Bluetooth and battery life, such as Samsung A20e, and using follower mode on parents' phones.
evidence_quote: Don't use a watch as a collector. It is much harder to use it (screen very small, battery and so on). Kid should come to school with a phone, put it in his bag, and things will still work. This phone should be the master.
